RESELLER AGREEMENT (fictional)

This Agreement is between Quillon Software Ltd (the "Vendor") and Ardent Systems Ltd (the "Reseller").

1. Term
1.1 This Agreement commences on 1 February 2026 and continues for three (3) years.

2. Reporting and payment
2.1 The Reseller shall submit sales reports within ten (10) Business Days after the end of each calendar quarter.
2.2 The Reseller must pay all invoices within thirty (30) days of the invoice date.

3. Notices
3.1 Each party shall give the other at least sixty (60) days' written notice of any change to its registered address.

4. Termination
4.1 The Vendor may terminate this Agreement immediately if the Reseller breaches clause 2.

LOAN AND GUARANTEE (fictional)

This Agreement is between First Harbor Bank (the "Lender"), Quayside Foods Ltd (the "Borrower") and Quayside Holdings Ltd (the "Guarantor").

1. Repayment
1.1 The Borrower shall repay the Loan in eight equal quarterly instalments starting on 31 March 2027.

2. Guarantee
2.1 The Guarantor shall pay any amount demanded within five (5) Business Days of a written demand.
